newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly easier, naphtha stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly easier, naphtha stable.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly softer on Friday but naphtha was steady, traders said.
Gasoline fell on a U.S. trader's aggressive selling. Eurograde barges traded down to $217 a tonne fob ARA.
Spot naphtha prices held notionally steady in thin trade but improving sentiment held January swaps firm.
Fuel barges lost $1 or so. High sulphur cargoes were steady, but low sulphur came under pressure from good supplies.
Gas oil shed $4.25 a tonne in line with futures. Premiums were steady. Transport problems curbed buying interest.
